InMemorySessionStore

class InMemorySessionStore : SessionStore

A simple, thread-safe, in-memory implementation of the SessionStore interface.

This store uses a ConcurrentHashMap to hold session data, making it suitable for development environments or single-server deployments.

Note: All session data is ephemeral and will be lost when the application stops.
